description: This file defines the class `GZIPRequestWrapper` which extends `HttpServletRequestWrapper` to handle GZIP-compressed HTTP request input streams, typically used in the context of a web filter to decompress GZIP data.

classes.name: GZIPRequestWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for HttpServletRequest that provides GZIP decompression functionality for incoming request streams.

methods.name: GZIPRequestWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with the original request and sets up the GZIP input stream.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns the wrapped input stream which handles GZIP decompression.
